component.name: Card
component.description: Structured content container with optional header, body, footer, and action slots.

slots.name: root
slots.description: Card container that frames the header, body, and footer regions.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Top region for title, description, custom header content, and actions.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Primary heading rendered in the card header.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text rendered below the card title.

slots.name: action
slots.description: Header action region, typically used for buttons or menus.

slots.name: body
slots.description: Main content region for the card children.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Bottom region for secondary actions or summary content.

own.name: action
own.description: Content to render in the action slot (usually a button in the header).

own.name: class
own.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

own.name: compact
own.description: Whether to use a compact layout.

own.name: footer
own.description: Content to render in the footer slot.

own.name: header
own.description: Content to render in the header slot, overrides title/description.

data.name: data-slot
data.description: Identifies the rendered slot for styling hooks and selectors.
